interface.longDescription:
Create images, videos, ads and audio in ChatGPT with more than 100 AI models in one place. Turn a product photo into a set of store photos, make a creator-style video ad with a script and a voice, or make several versions of one ad to test against each other.

Generate and edit images with models such as Nano Banana, GPT Image and FLUX. Animate a photo or make a clip from text with models such as Seedance, Veo and Kling, at 9:16 for TikTok, Reels and Shorts or 16:9 for YouTube. Make voiceovers, music and sound effects, SVG logos and icons, 3D models, and web pages or cards in editable layers.

Ask for an estimate before a run, and the plugin shows what the run costs on your account before anything starts. Your results land on a canvas at visualsandbox.com, where you can see the whole set side by side, use any picture as the reference for the next one, and share a link.

Generations are charged to your Visual Sandbox account. Results vary by model. For help, contact hello@visualsandbox.com.
capabilities: Edit images with a reference photo
Generate videos from text or images
Vertical video for TikTok, Reels and Shorts
Web pages and cards in editable layers
A shared canvas for every result
defaultPrompt: Turn this product photo into a clean studio hero shot and two lifestyle photos.
Make a 10-second vertical UGC video ad for my product with a short script.
Make four versions of this ad, each with a different headline.

positive.description: Text to image. Needs a demo account with credit.
positive.prompt: Generate an image of a cozy coffee shop interior in warm morning light.
positive.tools_triggered: list_models, get_model, generate, show_media (get_skill when the model reads a prompting pack first)
positive.expected_behavior: One generate call, then the Visual Sandbox card shows the finished image of the described scene, with a link to open it on visualsandbox.com. No extra paid variations.

positive.description: Read the account balance. Nothing is generated or charged.
positive.prompt: How much credit is left on my Visual Sandbox account?
positive.expected_behavior: States the balance in US dollars. Nothing is generated, nothing is charged, and no purchase link is offered.

positive.description: Product photo from an attached reference image. Needs image credit.
positive.prompt: Turn this product photo into a clean studio hero shot on a white background.
positive.expected_behavior: Uploads the attached photo, runs one image edit with it as the reference, and the card shows one hero shot in which the product keeps its shape, colour and label.

positive.description: Video with the price shown first. Needs video credit.
positive.prompt: Make a 5-second vertical video of a paper airplane flying through a bright studio. Tell me the price first.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the estimated price and waits for a yes before generate. The card shows the percent while the clip renders, then plays the finished 9:16 clip. A running job is not reported as a finished video.

positive.description: Stock voice narration. Needs speech credit.
positive.prompt: Read this line in a warm, friendly voice: Welcome to Visual Sandbox, your studio for images, video and sound.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks a stock voice, keeps the words exactly, and the card plays the finished audio.

negative.description: Written copy only. The request names Instagram, but asks for no media.
negative.prompt: Write three short Instagram captions for a coffee shop that launches an oat milk latte.

negative.description: A general question about video specs. The person wants an answer, not a generated file.
negative.prompt: What is the best aspect ratio and length for a YouTube Short?

negative.description: Finding an existing stock photo. Visual Sandbox makes new media and does not search stock libraries.
negative.prompt: Find me a stock photo of a mountain sunset that I can use in a presentation.

review.commerce_description: Visual Sandbox sells nothing in ChatGPT. The ChatGPT server address has no checkout or top-up tool and returns no purchase link. Generations are charged to the person's existing Visual Sandbox account. When the balance is too low, the plugin says so and says that credit is added on visualsandbox.com.

publication.release_notes: First release. Generate and edit images, videos, voiceovers, music, sound effects, SVGs and 3D models with more than 100 AI models. Includes guided setup, product photo shoots, UGC-style video ads and ad variations for testing. Every result lands on a shared canvas at visualsandbox.com.
